method: All source identities checked. Local node indices refer to pinned prior module inventories. Literal metadata uses UTF-8 byte spans; non-numeric string/bytes/other values stored as lexical character length, not copied. Direct reference bindings are restricted to simple one-line assignments confirmed by AST store/load; not a sound lifetime heap-alias result. Effect read/write links are same-statement candidates only. Scope call edges are candidate targets; exception edges overapproximate.
